persona.summary: Family bearing distributor (46.8 M EUR); we are 0.46 % and, since its refocus on key accounts, 'not strategic'. Sole source for the 7309 angular bearing; 70640 is an active second source for 6306/6308 and cheaper on 6306 (4.20 vs 4.39). Arena P04: barely moved (first counter -0.4 %), answered volume and delivery data with 'does not change our calculation', final offer by round 2. Package multi-year volume; use 70640's price.
persona.notes: Wants multi-year volume deals only; cites rising LCI-C and PPI-C2815. Contradiction: owner offered to walk us through costs (June), but in arena 'company policy' blocks any breakdown. Renewal mail asks our volumes. OTD 83-87 % vs 95 % target, ppm 283-387, yet delivery data did not move it.
fears: rising labour and bearing producer prices (LCI-C, PPI-C2815)

levers: payment days (it priced a 14-day option in arena)
arguments: binding volume commitment with volume schedule
notice period: price changes need written notice at least 60 days before year end (ctr 3.1)
avoid: delivery or forecast arguments alone (no change)
dragging rounds: final offer by round 2
changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Expect almost no price movement: secure the best package within the first two rounds.
Lead with 70640's lower price on 6306-2Z C3 (4.20 vs 4.39) and offer to shift quota.
Offer 36 months with a binding annual volume; it says only multi-year volume agreements change prices.
If it asks an increase, check contract 3.1: written notice is required at least 60 days before year end.
Accept its final offer as is; do not reopen any term.
playbook.expected_concession: Minimal: P04 first counter 0.4 % below its opening and final offer by round 2; most sessions ended at 4.94 (-0.4 %); best seen 4.88 (-1.6 %) with 36 months.
